size.value: Digital submission only (GOV.CV portal/app): 900–4500 pixels width × 1200–6000 pixels height, portrait aspect ratio 4:3 or 3:4, JPG/JPEG format, 250KB–10MB file size. No fixed cm/mm print size is published.

background.value: "Use um plano de fundo claro que não contenha objectos ou outras pessoas" — a light/plain background with no objects or other people

head_height.value: No cm/mm figure published. Qualitative framing only: head centered with free space around the sides and top ("cabeça centrada com um espaço livre ao redor dos lados e no topo"), and part of the shoulders or upper chest must be visible.

file_spec.value: JPG or JPEG format, 250KB–10MB file size, 900–4500px width × 1200–6000px height, portrait ratio 4:3 or 3:4. Scanned photos are not accepted ("As fotos digitalizadas não são aceitáveis"). Selfies are not permitted ("Sem selfies, pois pode distorcer o rosto").

expression_restriction.value: Neutral expression with mouth closed ("expressão neutra com a boca fechada")

glasses_policy.value: Glasses are allowed ("Pode usar óculos") if they are not sunglasses, colored, or thick-framed ("Eles não podem ser óculos de sol, coloridos ou com armação grossa"); no glare/flash reflection on lenses; a clear space must be visible between the eyes and the frames

face_visibility.value: Full frontal view ("Rosto à vista completa"), face turned toward the camera ("Com o rosto virado para a câmara"), eyes clearly visible

headwear_policy.value: No hats, hoods, bandanas, or headscarves ("Sem chapéus, capuz, badanas ou lenços na cabeça"), unless required for religious or medical reasons, in which case an endorsement on the applicant's ID document is required

expression.ko: 입을 다문 무표정(중립적인 표정)을 유지할 것.
expression.ja: 口を閉じた無表情(中立的な表情)であること。

glasses.en: Glasses are allowed if they are not sunglasses, tinted, or thick-framed, with no glare or flash reflection on the lenses, and a clear space visible between the eyes and the frames.
glasses.ko: 선글라스·색안경·두꺼운 테 안경이 아니라면 안경 착용이 가능하며, 렌즈에 빛 번짐이나 플래시 반사가 없어야 하고 눈과 안경테 사이 공간이 명확히 보여야 함.
glasses.ja: サングラス・色付きレンズ・太いフレームでなければ眼鏡の着用可。レンズに光の反射やフラッシュの映り込みがなく、目とフレームの間の隙間がはっきり見えること。

face_visibility.en: Full frontal view of the face, turned toward the camera, with eyes clearly visible.
face_visibility.ko: 얼굴이 카메라를 향한 완전한 정면 모습이어야 하며, 눈이 뚜렷하게 보여야 함.
face_visibility.ja: 顔がカメラの方を向いた完全な正面の状態であること。目がはっきり見えること。

headwear.en: No hats, hoods, bandanas, or scarves on the head, unless required for religious or medical reasons (in which case an endorsement on the ID document is needed).
headwear.ko: 모자·후드·반다나·스카프 등 머리 가리개 착용 금지 (단, 종교적·의료적 사유가 있는 경우 신분증에 배서가 필요함).
headwear.ja: 帽子・フード・バンダナ・スカーフなどの被り物は禁止(ただし宗教上・医療上の理由がある場合は身分証明書への裏書きが必要)。

db_conflicts.research_value: Digital-only: 900–4500px width × 1200–6000px height, portrait ratio 4:3 or 3:4. The current official process (GOV.CV portal/app) does not publish a fixed cm/mm print size at all; ratio 3:4 (0.75) is close to but not identical to the DB's 3.5:4.5 ratio (0.778).
"um plano de fundo claro" (a light/clear background) — the official text specifies "claro" (light), not explicitly "branco" (white)

No cm/mm figure published for head height. Official guidance is qualitative only ("cabeça centrada com um espaço livre ao redor dos lados e no topo" — head centered with free space around the sides and top; part of the shoulders/upper chest must be visible), consistent with the digital pixel-based capture standard reported under size — no physical unit is published against which to confirm or refute the DB's cm range

cross_verification.note: Source is the Portal Único (gov.cv) official 'Requisitos para Fotografias' page, linked directly from the passport application page ('Pedido ou Renovação do Passaporte'). This is a digital biometric-capture standard (photo uploaded via the GOV.CV smartphone app), which is why it specifies pixel dimensions and file size rather than a physical print size in cm. An earlier AI-summarized fetch of this page suggested an explicit 'ears visible' rule, but the raw HTML only mentions ears in the context of camera-distance guidance ('if the camera is too close, the nose and forehead may look bigger and the ears less visible') — not a standalone ears-visibility requirement, so ears_visibility was kept unverified rather than falsely confirmed.
